title: Fuego
identity: Georgia Nicolaou, Fuego (2012), for tenor saxophone and piano, Donemus D21505, approximately six minutes. The composer describes it as a contemporary tango and credits Sari-Anna Ikonen (tenor saxophone) and Carol Ruiz Gandia (piano). The seven-page Donemus preview includes the performance note and selected score pages.

evidence.claim: Composer page identifies the 2012 tenor-saxophone/piano work, calls it a contemporary tango, and credits Sari-Anna Ikonen and Carol Ruiz Gandia.

Donemus preview identifies Fuego, tenor saxophone and piano, the D21505 number and c. 6-minute duration. Its note asks for frequent eye contact and says the saxophonist may turn toward the piano strings while sustaining notes.

Visual inspection of the opening and later pages shows a q=92 4/4 opening, rests and irregularly accented sax entries over initially sparse piano, later saxophone growl markings, an extended rubato section, dense piano chords, and a later 2/4 passage. These are excerpts, not a complete-part survey.

score_observations.observation: The q=92 opening is in 4/4 with irregular saxophone entries and rests while the piano begins with long rests. Later page 5 shows written “growl” indications, a long held high saxophone note, a “Tempo rubato” subsection, dense piano chord clusters, and a shift into 2/4. The performance note explicitly requests eye contact and allows the saxophonist to turn toward the piano strings during long notes.

review_focus: Inference from the score and performance note: review ensemble cueing around rests and rubato, tone control during the held-note piano-string effect, and transitions between notated meter/tempo sections. Full range is unknown from the selected pages.
collection_flag: Original tenor saxophone/piano work with composer-identified performers and an explicit composer performance note.

listening.description: Composer page embeds Fuego performance by Sari-Anna Ikonen, tenor saxophone, and Carol Ruiz Gandia, piano.
listening.verification: Performance and credits verified on opened composer page; not auditioned.
